items.name: clump_ivy
items.prompt: Sprite sheet for a cel-shaded 3D game drawn like a hand-painted anime background: four separate hanging ivy and creeper vine curtains arranged in a 2 by 2 grid, each centered in its own quarter with clear empty space around it, transparent background, nothing else. Each one is a dense mass of small ivy leaves that starts as a thick straight horizontal band along the very top of its quarter (as if growing over the top edge of a wall) and drapes downward in uneven hanging strands of different lengths, wider than tall, front view, flat against a wall. Painted in two flat tones of green (fresh lit green and darker shade green), a few yellowish leaves. Flat matte colors, no gradients, no black outlines, no wall, no stems sticking out sideways, no text.
